moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: I resigned… Neither company is acting responsibly. They are racing straight to self‑improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives.
moments.why: A chilling insider AI resignation thread warning about existential risk — blew up across industry and public debate.

moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: His post on X … drew over 100 million views
moments.why: The sheer view count underscores how much this thread has gripped the culture and AI-conscious men in this age group.

moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: Evan Hubinger publicly backed the core concern saying AI could kill all humans and puts probability above 10% this decade.
moments.why: The voice of the alignment lead inside Anthropic validating the doomsday warning amplified the controversy.
